mapper.select: select (select count(*) from orders o where (#{shopId} is null or o.shop_id = #{shopId})) as orderCount, (select ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) from orders o where (#{shopId} is null or o.shop_id = #{shopId}) and o.payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED')) as salesAmount, (select count(*) from orders o where (#{shopId} is null or o.shop_id = #{shopId}) and o.order_status in ('PAID', 'CONFIRMED', 'FULFILLING') and o.fulfillment_status != 'FULFILLED') as pendingShipmentCount, (select count(*) from refunds r inner join orders o on o.order_id = r.order_id where (#{shopId} is null or o.shop_id = #{shopId}) and r.refund_status in ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED', 'PROCESSING')) as refundCount, (select ifnull(sum(r.amount), 0) from refunds r inner join orders o on o.order_id = r.order_id where (#{shopId} is null or o.shop_id = #{shopId}) and r.refund_status in ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCEEDED')) as refundAmount, (select count(*) from product_spu p where (#{shopId} is null or p.shop_id = #{shopId})) as productCount, (select count(*) from product_spu p where (#{shopId} is null or p.shop_id = #{shopId}) and p.status = 'ON_SALE') as onSaleProductCount

select count(*) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as grossAmount from orders o where o.shop_id = #{shopId} and ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time) >= #{beginTime} and ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time) < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) and o.payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED')

select date_format(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time), '%m-%d') as d, count(*) as orders, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as amount from orders o where ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) and (#{shopId} is null or o.shop_id = #{shopId}) and o.payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED') group by date_format(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time), '%m-%d') order by min(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time))

select o.customer_id as customerId, c.customer_no as customerNo, c.email as email, c.display_name as displayName, c.country_code as countryCode, count(o.order_id) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as totalAmount, max(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time)) as lastOrderTime from orders o inner join customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id where (#{shopId} is null or o.shop_id = #{shopId})
and (c.display_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.customer_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
group by o.customer_id, c.customer_no, c.email, c.display_name, c.country_code order by totalAmount desc

select (select ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) from orders o where o.payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED')) as gmv, (select count(*) from orders) as orderCount, (select ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) from orders o where date(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time)) = curdate()) as todayGmv, (select count(*) from orders o where date(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time)) = curdate()) as todayOrderCount, (select count(*) from shop) as shopCount, (select count(*) from shop where status = 'ACTIVE') as activeShopCount, (select count(*) from channel_config where status = 'ACTIVE') as channelCount, (select ifnull(sum(r.amount), 0) from refunds r where r.refund_status = 'SUCCEEDED') as refundAmount

select date_format(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time), '%m-%d') as d, count(*) as orders, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as amount from orders o where ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) and o.payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED') group by date_format(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time), '%m-%d') order by min(ifnull(o.placed_at, o.create_time))

select s.shop_id as shopId, s.shop_code as shopCode, s.shop_name as shopName, s.status as status, ifnull(sum(case when o.payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED') then o.total_amount else 0 end), 0) as gmv, count(o.order_id) as orderCount from shop s left join orders o on o.shop_id = s.shop_id group by s.shop_id, s.shop_code, s.shop_name, s.status order by gmv desc limit 10

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.email as email, u.phonenumber as phonenumber, u.status as status, u.create_time as createTime, su.shop_id as shopId, sh.shop_name as shopName, su.shop_role as shopRole, su.status as shopUserStatus from sys_user u left join shop_user su on su.user_id = u.user_id left join shop sh on sh.shop_id = su.shop_id where u.del_flag = '0'
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%'))
and su.shop_id = #{shopId}
order by u.user_id desc
